mode: Built-in image_gen; six separate reference-based edits
reference: User-supplied six-card mockup; headings, copy, numbering and arrows removed from the generated background plates.

prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: clean full-bleed background illustration for ONE portfolio card, landscape 2:1 (1536x768). Input image is the user's six-card reference mockup. Reconstruct ONLY the requested card's illustration as an independent edge-to-edge image. Match that card's scenery, subjects, camera angle, saturated electric blue space fantasy 3D realism, cyan light, dark rocks, stars and glowing nebula as closely as possible. Remove the card border and ALL overlaid portfolio text (Polish heading, description), top-left number and dash, and bottom-left round arrow button. These will NOT be baked into the image. This is a richly illustrated full card, NOT a split layout: scene, stars, nebula, rock silhouettes and reflected blue light must continue across the ENTIRE width including the left third and bottom-left. Upper-left region is naturally darker and lower detail to support HTML title/copy, but it MUST NOT be an empty solid black panel, half-black background, vertical seam or a flat gradient wipe. Use continuous atmospheric depth with asymmetric naturally dark rocks/nebula. Keep key object cluster mainly in the right 60%, with rocky foreground across full bottom. No outer frame, no collage, no full website, no numbers, no arrow icons, no watermark. Requested card: TOP LEFT, INTERFEJSY. A large silver desktop monitor in the upper-right, a silver laptop in the lower-middle-right, a tall tablet showing code beside it and smartphone at far right. All screens display a coherent blue snow-capped mountain/galaxy interface, except the coding tablet. Devices on reflective rocky blue alien ground, crisp detailed rocks across bottom-left, midnight starry nebula across upper-left. Match the reference device arrangement, with four different device sizes and no giant moon or additional planets. The laptop can overlap the lower middle, the desktop extends to the top-right.
